items.headline: Nike Faces 2 Major Tests This Week. Earnings Isn't the One To Watch
items.summary: Nike's (NKE +1.79%) running business may be on the rebound, but the sportswear giant is definitely limping into its first-quarter earnings report, due out on Thursday. The stock is trading around decade lows heading into the big reveal, and Wall Street is lowering its expectations for a comeback.
